overall_notes: This paper focuses on evaluating reasoning capabilities through question answering rather than traditional NLG evaluation. While it involves generation (question/rationale generation), the evaluation is primarily through multiple-choice accuracy metrics rather than standard NLG metrics. The human evaluations are comprehensive but focus on reasoning quality rather than text generation quality.
